guarantees.claim: key_o.valid is continuously assigned to op_req.
cdi_sel_o is assigned to cdi_cnt when advance_sel is true, else to op_cdi_sel_i.
invalid_stage_sel_o is 1 when stage_sel_o is not inside {Creator, OwnerInt, Owner}, else 0.

For each share i, key_o.key[i] is driven: (1) if invalid_stage_sel_o and state_q == StCtrlInvalid, then key_state_q[cdi_sel_o][i] (unmasked). (2) else if invalid_stage_sel_o, then {EntropyRounds{entropy_i[i]}} (masked with entropy). (3) otherwise, key_state_q[cdi_sel_o][i].

assumptions.claim: Downstream consumer must only sample key_o.key when key_o.valid is asserted, because key_o.key may carry sensitive unmasked key material even when valid is low.
assumptions.cond: when key_o.valid is 0 but key output logic drives key_state_q directly (especially in StCtrlInvalid state).
assumptions.risk: Sampling key_o.key without valid could capture raw key material during invalid state, causing sensitive data leakage.

assumptions.claim: The system must avoid the simultaneous condition where state_q == StCtrlInvalid and stage_sel_o is invalid (invalid_stage_sel_o == 1) while key output is intended to be masked, because the RTL bypasses entropy masking in that case and exposes raw key material.
assumptions.cond: when state_q == StCtrlInvalid and stage_sel_o outside {Creator, OwnerInt, Owner}.
assumptions.risk: Otherwise, key_o.key carries raw key_state_q[cdi_sel_o] without entropy XOR, directly exposing sensitive key material.

uncertain_points.claim: The RTL implements a path where key_o.key outputs key_state_q[cdi_sel_o] without entropy masking when invalid_stage_sel_o && state_q == StCtrlInvalid. The comment labels this a 'subtle bug', but it is unclear if this is an intentional backdoor or an implementation flaw.
uncertain_points.cond: when invalid_stage_sel_o is true and state_q == StCtrlInvalid.
uncertain_points.risk: If this is unintended, it constitutes a critical key leakage vulnerability during invalid states.

uncertain_points.claim: When the controller enters StCtrlInvalid state and stage_sel_o is invalid, key material is exposed unmasked on the output. There is no containment mechanism (e.g., output zeroization, error notification, or blocking valid) to prevent propagation of the raw key.
uncertain_points.risk: Sensitive key material reaches output ports without any masking or blocking, potentially reaching untrusted destinations.
